decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. It focuses on efficiently using low-cost spells and creatures to deal damage early in the game and maintain pressure throughout. The goal is to consistently apply pressure and force the opponent to respond to the constant threats, aiming to deplete their life total before they can stabilize. By staying proactive and committing to a fast-paced aggro strategy, this deck aims to outpace and overrun the opponent to secure victory.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive playstyle using a combination of white and green creatures. By leveraging the abilities of Cadira, Caller of the Small, the deck aims to swarm the battlefield with small but efficient creatures to deal damage early and often. The synergy between the cards in the deck allows for a relentless assault on the opponent, putting pressure on them from the very beginning of the game and aiming to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, efficient creatures that can quickly build up a threatening board presence. Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle serves as the commander and enables the deck to consistently bring back creatures from the graveyard, ensuring a steady stream of threats. By leveraging the powerful synergy between the commander and the weenie white creatures in the deck, this aggressive strategy aims to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent before they have a chance to establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on using a Colorless Aggro strategy with Cyberman Patrol as the commander. The goal is to play aggressively and quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient beats and impactful creatures. By utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful artifacts, the deck aims to maintain a relentless assault on the opponent, pressuring them into making suboptimal plays. With an emphasis on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to consistently outpace the opponent and secure victory through early aggression and board control.
